name: Destitute Widow Pension Scheme - Uttarakhand
benefit: A pension of ₹1,500/- per month is provided to eligible beneficiaries.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a resident of Uttarakhand. 1. The applicant must be a widow. 1. The widow must be at least 18 years of age. 1. The widow’s family monthly income should not exceed ₹4,000/-, or she must possess a valid BPL (Below Poverty Line) certificate. 1. The widow must not be receiving any other pension benefits.
